cases.name: applied-pair-keeps-current-markers
schema_sql: CREATE TRIGGER keep_refresh_current AFTER UPDATE OF last_processed_at,journal_input_version ON profiles BEGIN UPDATE profiles SET last_processed_at='2026-10-31T12:00:00Z',last_processed_tx_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE profile_id=NEW.id AND excluded=0),last_processed_input_version=journal_input_version WHERE id=NEW.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER keep_refresh_semantics AFTER UPDATE OF journal_semantics_version ON profiles WHEN NEW.journal_semantics_version=0 BEGIN UPDATE profiles SET journal_semantics_version=2 WHERE id=NEW.id; END
